name: documented-skill-contract
description: Restores AgentAssets native-skill/template files from a local backup back to their tenant locations, dry-run by default with an explicit confirmation gate.
prompt: Use the restore-sharepoint-native-skills skill according to its SKILL.md. State the expected inputs, outputs, safety boundaries, and what the skill must not do.
expected: Uses the skill documented in SKILL.md
Identifies the required input artifacts or parameters
Identifies the expected output or report artifact
